Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Hearts of Three", "unit": 15, "heading": "CHAPTER XIII", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "ru78-u015-r0014", "target": "— Где же эти следы, старый жрец? — потребовал ответа Генри, оглядываясь на нетронутый травяной ковёр.", "source_sha256": "89480c144e9dac95157c0eb9e0115ef13888aa91e09bc40c4463454d8bb3abe2", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u015-r0014", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "772514924509bdb9b3a55e70be3f7ce0df9fedbb9aeca5ac9433c319ce36d5f9"}, {"source_id": "ru78-u015-r0015", "target": "Но старик тронул мула и, выбив голыми пятками дробь по рёбрам животного, поспешно погнал его через поляну и дальше, в джунгли.", "source_sha256": "8afc155aed05bfa69ae0b0ce6f59e53a4b462d6d341485abd6525ccc9d2ec449", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u015-r0015", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "d0f0374c054734f1bb8c4253c0c9789d40e808b7fdcbe61a2bcc8e0b275d6b8a"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u015-r0016", "tag": "p", "text": "“He’s like a hound on the scent, and it looks as if the scent is getting hot,” Francis remarked.", "sha256": "1e480631b4596d42ddffcecad32b44482cbf9bebdc65e3588a08e68da2dddb55", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1161]", "source_html": "

127“He’s like a hound on the scent, and it looks as if the scent is getting hot,” Francis remarked.

Three feet or more in depth, of area sufficient to accommodate a dozen persons in comfort, its form was strikingly like that which some colossal human foot could have made.", "sha256": "c617d4d2e916ec959a7a18291e842d7a78d203676497452658ef9c96b274baf1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1162]", "source_html": "

At the end of half a mile, where the jungle turned to grass-land on swift-rising slopes the old man forced his mule into a gallop which he maintained until he reached a natural depression in the ground. Three feet or more in depth, of area sufficient to accommodate a dozen persons in comfort, its form was strikingly like that which some colossal human foot could have made.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0018", "tag": "p", "text": "“The foot-step of the God,” the old priest proclaimed solemnly, ere he slid off his mule and prostrated himself in prayer. “[[I]]In the foot-step of the God must we wait till the eyes of Chia flash[[/I]]——so say the sacred knots.”", "sha256": "57e06887806468b2db53c7baf391261981219259ef455016381a8b132451005c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1163]", "source_html": "

“The foot-step of the God,” the old priest proclaimed solemnly, ere he slid off his mule and prostrated himself in prayer. “In the foot-step of the God must we wait till the eyes of Chia flash——so say the sacred knots.”

", "emphasis_spans": 1}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0019", "tag": "p", "text": "“Pretty good place for a meal,” Henry vouchsafed, looking down into the depression. “While waiting for the mumbo-jumbo foolery to come off, we might as well stay our stomachs.”", "sha256": "5b55491585b00fe3a3be3d688330822ff3a8bf1ad20f96a742dc5a0a2e0a22ac", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1164]", "source_html": "

“Pretty good place for a meal,” Henry vouchsafed, looking down into the depression. “While waiting for the mumbo-jumbo foolery to come off, we might as well stay our stomachs.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0020", "tag": "p", "text": "“If Chia doesn’t object,” laughed Francis.", "sha256": "33599585b8b8ae879538eadbb8231061084506c678f04bdb3662d2c7675f55a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1165]", "source_html": "

“If Chia doesn’t object,” laughed Francis.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0021", "tag": "p", "text": "And Chia did not object, at least the old priest could not find any objection written in the knots.", "sha256": "61138dcccc0d6ae466d497569aaa04242a5f018bca22189f67f22248a99bb7e1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1166]", "source_html": "

And Chia did not object, at least the old priest could not find any objection written in the knots.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0022", "tag": "p", "text": "While the mules were being tethered on the edge of the first break of woods, water was fetched from a nearby spring and a fire built in the foot-step. The old Maya seemed oblivious of everything, as he mumbled endless prayers and ran the knots over and over.", "sha256": "684ed0eb5c27805e7e02258c3fc55eb6a4e486570465af2fba2130036f4d1dd0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1167]", "source_html": "

While the mules were being tethered on the edge of the first break of woods, water was fetched from a nearby spring and a fire built in the foot-step. The old Maya seemed oblivious of everything, as he mumbled endless prayers and ran the knots over and over.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0023", "tag": "p", "text": "“If only he doesn’t blow up,” Francis said.", "sha256": "c81cdf5e23862ea3cd0450ecff90d1c912298c9d7de6ec7fffbe412cfe45d839", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1168]", "source_html": "

“If only he doesn’t blow up,” Francis said.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0024", "tag": "p", "text": "“I thought he was wild-eyed the first day we met him up in Juchitan,” concurred Henry. “But it’s nothing to the way his eyes are now.”", "sha256": "be9f1eaac580d11dcaa1799f2461631cd594405a7a0d217dbeb9cfea6b687c95", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1169]", "source_html": "

“I thought he was wild-eyed the first day we met him up in Juchitan,” concurred Henry. “But it’s nothing to the way his eyes are now.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0025", "tag": "p", "text": "Here spoke the peon, who, unable to understand a word of their English, nevertheless sensed the drift of it.", "sha256": "e3f5b90ad0ca78cc677c72e286fc42400da8c5e933ae8a0d6a90413cd9852712", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1170]", "source_html": "

Here spoke the peon, who, unable to understand a word of their English, nevertheless sensed the drift of it.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0026", "tag": "p", "text": "“This is very religious, very dangerous, to have anything to do with the old Maya sacred things. It is the death-road. My father knows. Many men have died. The deaths are sudden and horrible. Even Maya priests have died. My father’s father so died. He, too, loved a woman of the tierra caliente. And for love of her, for gold, he sold the Maya secret and by the knot-writing led tierra caliente men to the treasure. He died. They all died. My father does not like the women of the tierra caliente now that he is old. He liked them too well in his youth, which was his sin. And he knows the danger of leading you to the treasure. Many men have sought during the centuries. Of those who found it, not one came back. It is said that even conquistadores and pirates of the English Morgan have won to the hiding-place and decorated it with their bones.”", "sha256": "837c7d495c4e18a00a9f6ec9e56b8506bb620f75fc87ec61eed658a38a667db6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1171]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0027", "tag": "p", "text": "“And when your father dies,” Francis queried, “then, being his son, you will be the Maya high priest?”", "sha256": "a4ee5b3235ffe99274de3fa59963608bccf9e151656540f5a6ac009844d21052", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1172]", "source_html": "

“And when your father dies,” Francis queried, “then, being his son, you will be the Maya high priest?”

“No, senor,” the peon shook his head. “I am only half-Maya. I cannot read the knots. My father did not teach me because I was not of the pure Maya blood.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u015-r0029", "tag": "p", "text": "“And if he should die, right now, is there any other Maya who can read the knots?”", "sha256": "f3fe264a16aaa899f8dfe757f14697fc713d81ff6b253962421725dee58bb547", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1174]", "source_html": "

“And if he should die, right now, is there any other Maya who can read the knots?”

“No, senor. My father is the last living man who knows that ancient language.”

Also, they insisted on her returning with Ricardo.", "sha256": "85863e1c38760ec9cf3b13f4a659ed31fc5e7eee6cc0c03938ff044675918f0d", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1176]", "source_html": "

But the conversation was broken in upon by Leoncia and Ricardo, who, having tethered their mules with the others, were gazing sheepishly down from the rim of the depression.
